faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 5 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Senior Research Fellow, 1 Young Professional-1.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 5 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years. Relaxation: SC As per rule, ST As per rule, NT As per rule, OBC As per rule.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA for Senior Research Fellow, Rs. 30,000 Fixed per month for Young Professional-1.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. (Agril. Entomology) / B.Sc. Agriculture / Diploma (Agri.). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate with two-wheeler license will be preferred. Purely on temporary basis up to 31.03.2027 or as per availability of budget.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny and verification of original documents. Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment will be on contract basis up to 31.03.2027 or as per availability of budget. No claim for regular appointment under VNMKV, Parbhani.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.
